summary: HTTPStorageBackend — backend for HTTP/HTTPS storage via httpx. Implements read (GET), write (PUT), metadata (HEAD for exists/size/content-type). Registered for CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE.HTTP. Supports Bearer and Basic auth passed via HTTPSettings. Does not implement list, copy, or delete protocols (UnsupportedOperationError). Added in Phase 5 (2026-05-07).
lifecycle_notes: list, copy, delete not implemented — HTTP protocol does not universally support these
risks: PUT write semantics require server cooperation — not all HTTP servers allow PUT
open_questions: Should DELETE HTTP method be implemented for delete protocol?
